title: Prime Minister extends greetings on National Sports Day
body_text: The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has extended his greetings to all sports lovers on National Sports Day. Shri Modi said that the dedication, passion and determination of sportspersons make the entire nation proud. The Prime Minister also paid homage to the legendary Major Dhyan Chand Ji, whose brilliance and contribution to Indian hockey continue to inspire generations. Shri Modi posted on X: “To every sports lover…your dedication, passion and determination make everyone proud. We also pay homage to the legendary Major Dhyan Chand Ji, whose brilliance inspires generations. #NationalSportsDay” To every sports lover…your dedication, passion and determination make everyone proud. We also pay homage to the legendary Major Dhyan Chand Ji, whose brilliance inspires generations. #NationalSportsDay pic.twitter.com/uwzxCWPmuW — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) August 29, 2026 ************* MJPS/SS/ST (Release ID: 2304465) Visitor Counter : 366 Read this release in: Urdu , हिन्दी , Marathi , Bengali , Assamese , Gujarati

enrichment.summary: On National Sports Day (29 August, Major Dhyan Chand's birth anniversary), Prime Minister Narendra Modi extended greetings to sports lovers, praising athletes' dedication and passion, and paid tribute to hockey legend Major Dhyan Chand.
enrichment.context: National Sports Day is observed annually on 29 August to mark the birth anniversary of Major Dhyan Chand, widely regarded as one of the greatest hockey players in history, who won three Olympic gold medals for India. The day is used to promote awareness about sports and honour sporting achievement, and is also linked to the National Sports Awards ceremonies typically held around this date. This release is a routine greeting message with no new policy announcement.
